queries.name: servidores_inventory_non_secret
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), sc.id) AS connection_id,
    sc.nombre,
    sc.tipo_conexion,
    sc.system_type,
    sc.activo,
    sc.visible_en_operaciones,
    sc.visible_en_listado,
    sc.es_editable_ui,
    sc.es_eliminable_ui,
    sc.database_name,
    sc.EmpresaID,
    sc.empresa_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sc.host,''))), '') IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS host_configured,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sc.api_url,''))), '') IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS api_url_configured,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sc.username,''))), '') IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS username_configured,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sc.password_encrypted,''))), '') IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS password_configured,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sc.api_key_encrypted,''))), '') IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS api_key_configured,
    CASE
      WHEN ISNULL(sc.tipo_conexion,'DATA_SOURCE')='API_LOCAL'
        THEN 'API_CONNECTIONS'
      WHEN ISNULL(sc.tipo_conexion,'DATA_SOURCE')='CORE'
        THEN 'CORE_SUPERADMIN_ONLY'
      ELSE 'SERVERS'
    END AS expected_source_contract,
    CASE
      WHEN sc.activo=1
       AND ISNULL(sc.visible_en_listado,1)=1
       AND ISNULL(sc.tipo_conexion,'DATA_SOURCE') NOT IN ('API_LOCAL','CORE')
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS expected_in_servers_endpoint,
    CASE
      WHEN ISNULL(sc.tipo_conexion,'DATA_SOURCE')<>'CORE'
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS expected_in_integrations_center_pre_rbac,
    sc.updated_at
FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc
ORDER BY sc.tipo_conexion, sc.nombre

queries.name: cavas_cienfuegos_focus
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), sc.id) AS connection_id,
    sc.nombre,
    sc.tipo_conexion,
    sc.system_type,
    sc.activo,
    sc.visible_en_operaciones,
    sc.visible_en_listado,
    sc.database_name,
    sc.EmpresaID,
    sc.empresa_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sc.host,''))), '') IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS host_configured,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sc.api_url,''))), '') IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS api_url_configured,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sc.password_encrypted,''))), '') IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS password_configured,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(sc.api_key_encrypted,''))), '') IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS api_key_configured
FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc
WHERE
    UPPER(ISNULL(sc.nombre,'')) LIKE '%CAVA%'
 OR UPPER(ISNULL(sc.nombre,'')) LIKE '%CIENFUEGOS%'
 OR UPPER(ISNULL(sc.database_name,'')) LIKE '%CAVA%'
 OR UPPER(ISNULL(sc.database_name,'')) LIKE '%CIENFUEGOS%'
ORDER BY sc.nombre

queries.name: servidores_health_sanitized
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), e.ServidorID) AS connection_id,
    sc.nombre,
    e.EstadoConexion,
    e.UltimoCheck,
    e.UltimaPruebaUTC,
    e.UltimoExitoUTC,
    e.UltimoErrorUTC,
    e.UltimoErrorCodigo,
    e.LatenciaMs,
    e.UltimoSyncUTC,
    e.UltimoSyncExitosoUTC,
    e.FechaActualizacionUTC,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(e.UltimoErrorMensaje,''))), '') IS NULL
        THEN NULL
      WHEN LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%401%'
        OR LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%403%'
        OR LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%login%'
        OR LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%auth%'
        OR LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%password%'
        THEN 'AUTH'
      WHEN LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%timeout%'
        OR LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%timed out%'
        THEN 'TIMEOUT'
      WHEN LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%network%'
        OR LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%connect%'
        OR LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%host%'
        THEN 'CONNECTIVITY'
      WHEN LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%certificate%'
        OR LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%ssl%'
        OR LOWER(e.UltimoErrorMensaje) LIKE '%tls%'
        THEN 'TLS'
      ELSE 'OTHER'
    END AS sanitized_error_class
FROM dbo.Servidores_ConexionEstado e
LEFT JOIN dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc
  ON sc.id=e.ServidorID
ORDER BY sc.nombre

queries.name: servidores_unit_scope
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), sc.id) AS connection_id,
    sc.nombre,
    COUNT(u.id) AS unit_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(u.activo,0)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_unit_count
FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc
LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio u
  ON u.server_id=sc.id
GROUP BY sc.id, sc.nombre
ORDER BY sc.nombre

queries.name: servidores_company_role_scope
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), sc.id) AS connection_id,
    sc.nombre,
    COUNT(ses.ServidorID) AS company_role_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ses.Activo,0)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_company_role_rows
FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc
LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_EmpresasServidores ses
  ON ses.ServidorID=sc.id
GROUP BY sc.id, sc.nombre
ORDER BY sc.nombre
